description: Container-version operations. action "publish" pushes a version live (replacing the currently published one; requires the tagmanager.publish scope; version_id required, fingerprint recommended). action "get" fetches one version by version_id. action "live" fetches the currently published version of the container (no version_id needed). Publish responses can carry compilerError=true with HTTP 200 — reported as an error. Returns the ContainerVersion (publish wraps it as { containerVersion, compilerError }).

fingerprint.description: The version's last-seen fingerprint ("publish" only), for optimistic-concurrency safety.

version_id.description: Container version id (string). Required for "publish" and "get"; ignored for "live".

name: publish_version
title: Publish, inspect or fetch the live container version
